title: Height-Balanced Invariant Preservation in a Swift Aho-Corasick Multi-Pattern Automaton

abstract: The Aho-Corasick automaton is a canonical solution for simultaneous pattern matching, yet its practical deployment in modern systems demands rigorous guarantees on structural balance and failure-link propagation. We present a Swift implementation that constructs a height-balanced trie and computes failure links while preserving a strict height-balanced invariant. The design guarantees that each node's depth is bounded by $O(\log N)$, where $N$ is the number of patterns, and that the failure-link graph remains a directed acyclic graph with bounded fan-in. Formal invariants are proven using automated AST inspection and static analysis on an AMD EPYC 9V45 platform. The resulting automaton achieves linear-time construction and $O(|T|)$ search, with verified asymptotic bounds and a concise source code repository. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/swift-systems-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261017_150116_aho-corasick_multi-pattern_str}
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints
